name: db-plugin
mb-note-no-test-target: Deliberate — see the Testing section in CLAUDE.md. Tests run via `pnpm test` (root Vitest workspace) or `pnpm vitest run --project db-plugin`.
mb-note-no-build-target: Consumed through the tsconfig.base.json path mapping (`@mirrorbase/db-plugin`) and bundled by its consumers, like libs/ui. `typecheck` is what `pnpm check` runs instead, because Vitest's esbuild transform does not type-check.
